punchline: Tolle says that when you marry someone you also marry their pain-body, and it shows up over something trivial.
thirty_sec: Eckhart Tolle says unfaced emotions leave behind an energy field he calls the pain-body. It sleeps for weeks, then wakes at the smallest trigger and feeds on your thoughts, or on a fight with someone close. His fix is to notice it as a heavy wave of negative emotion in the body, because once recognised it can no longer pass itself off as you.
